name: hd44780
title: HD44780 character LCD

ways.do: RW to ground, D0 to D3 left open

notes: The chip has no I2C: a product with a PCF8574 backpack soldered on says so with on.i2c of its own.
RS, RW and DB0 to DB7 are pulled up to VCC inside the chip, E is not.

facts.source: boards-data, flashed or checked against the schematic

datasheet.source: Hitachi HD44780U (LCD-II), ADE-207-272(Z) Rev. 0.0 '99.9, the copy of soldered.com (sha256 7abafd9e...): at VCC 4.5 to 5.5 V VIH1 2.2 V, at 2.7 to 4.5 V 0.7 VCC; pull-up MOS 50 to 250 uA on DB0-DB7, RS, R/W at 5 V, none on E; DB0 to DB3 unused in 4-bit operation
